name: Hermes guest convergence - Hermes setup
review_question: Is this Ansible play excessively large and in need of decomposition?
source_context:
1: ---
     2: - name: Hermes guest convergence - Hermes setup
     3:   # Hermes guest convergence - HERMES SETUP phase. Runs during the egress install
     4:   # window because the installer and tirith download need network access. Assumes
     5:   # setup-os.yml has mounted and owned the persistent Hermes state directory and
     6:   # prepared the service user's shell.
     7:   #
     8:   # Installs, all as the unprivileged `hermes` service user:
     9:   #   - the Hermes Agent (Nous installer) + its tirith pre-exec scanner,
    10:   #   - the OpenCode, Claude Code, and Codex coding-agent CLIs.
    11:   # Every install uses each vendor's official method (curl installer or GitHub
    12:   # release binary) — deliberately NOT npm: the guest egress firewall admits the
    13:   # vendors' installer/API/GitHub endpoints but not registry.npmjs.org.
    14:   #
    15:   # Run order: setup-os (egress open) -> setup-hermes (egress open) -> lock egress
    16:   # -> configure.
    17:   #
    18:   # Target only the host AAP passes via ansible_limit (e.g. hermes-hermes from the
    19:   # kubevirt dynamic inventory). `hosts: all` would run the installer across the
    20:   # whole fleet - match the linux_baseline convention instead.
    21:   hosts: "{{ ansible_limit | default('hermes-hermes') }}"
    22:   become: true
    23:   # Facts are gathered in pre_tasks after the connection is proven, so a
    24:   # freshly provisioned VM (whose sshd may not be up yet) doesn't fail at play
    25:   # start. For the live hermes VM the wait returns immediately.
    26:   gather_facts: false
    27:   vars:
    28:     hermes_user: hermes
    29:     hermes_home: /home/hermes
    30:     hermes_state_mount: "{{ hermes_home }}/.hermes"
    31:     hermes_install_url: "https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh"
    32:     # Non-sudo / service-user install: skip browser automation. A working browser
    33:     # needs system Chromium libs from `sudo npx playwright install-deps chromium`
    34:     # (a sudo/admin step that doesn't fit the non-sudo service-user model), so the
    35:     # installer would otherwise leave a non-functional Chromium in ~/.cache. Flip
    36:     # to false only after running that admin step out of band.
    37:     hermes_install_skip_browser: true
    38:     # NB: hermes_install_agent is NOT set here as a play var. Play vars outrank
    39:     # inventory group_vars, so defining it here would shadow a group_vars
    40:     # override (e.g. group_vars/hermes_test.yml sets it false for the broker-only
    41:     # test). It is referenced as `hermes_install_agent | default(true)` in the
    42:     # task conditions below, so it defaults to true (full agent) unless a
    43:     # group/host var sets it.
    44:     # Default broker minting policy (deny-not-clamp). Override with
    45:     # hermes_ghapp_policy. Scratch repos only until go-live widens it.
    46:     hermes_ghapp_policy_default:
    47:       allowed_repos:
    48:         - david-igou/hermes_github_app_plugin
    49:         - igou-io/igou-infrastructure
    50:       max_permissions:
    51:         contents: write
    52:         pull_requests: write
    53:         issues: write
    54:       default_permissions:
    55:         contents: read
    56:   pre_tasks:
    57:     - name: Wait for the VM's SSH to come up
    58:       ansible.builtin.wait_for_connection:
    59:         timeout: 300
    60: 
    61:     - name: Gather facts (after the connection is proven)
    62:       ansible.builtin.setup:
    63: 
    64:   tasks:
    65:     # When the full agent stack is skipped (broker-only test convergence), the
    66:     # linux_baseline step that normally creates the hermes service user isn't
    67:     # run, so ensure it here. For the live hermes flow (agent install on),
    68:     # setup-os already created the user and this is skipped.
    69:     - name: Ensure the hermes service user exists (broker-only convergence)
    70:       ansible.builtin.user:
    71:         name: "{{ hermes_user }}"
    72:         home: "{{ hermes_home }}"
    73:         shell: /bin/bash
    74:         create_home: true
    75:         state: present
    76:       become: true
    77:       when: not (hermes_install_agent | default(true) | bool)
    78: 
    79:     - name: Enable lingering for the hermes user (broker-only convergence)
    80:       ansible.builtin.command:
    81:         cmd: "loginctl enable-linger {{ hermes_user }}"
    82:       args:
    83:         creates: "/var/lib/systemd/linger/{{ hermes_user }}"
    84:       become: true
    85:       when: not (hermes_install_agent | default(true) | bool)
    86: 
    87:     - name: Own the Hermes state mount to the hermes user
    88:       ansible.builtin.file:
    89:         path: "{{ hermes_state_mount }}"
    90:         state: directory
    91:         owner: "{{ hermes_user }}"
    92:         group: "{{ hermes_user }}"
    93:         recurse: true
    94:       become: true
    95: 
    96:     - name: Install Hermes Agent as the hermes user
    97:       ansible.builtin.shell:
    98:         # The installer prompts interactively (setup wizard + "install gateway as a
    99:         # service?") and falls back to /dev/tty even with no TTY, hanging under Ansible.
   100:         # --non-interactive --skip-setup runs it unattended; --skip-browser keeps it
   101:         # non-sudo (hermes_install_skip_browser).
   102:         cmd: >-
   103:           set -o pipefail && curl -fsSL {{ hermes_install_url }}
   104:           | bash -s -- --non-interactive --skip-setup{{ ' --skip-browser' if hermes_install_skip_browser else '' }}
   105:         creates: "{{ hermes_home }}/.local/bin/hermes"
   106:         executable: /bin/bash
   107:       become: true
   108:       become_user: "{{ hermes_user }}"
   109:       # hermes is a service user that may have a nologin shell; -i forces a login
   110:       # shell so the install script gets a sane $HOME/$PATH environment.
   111:       become_flags: '-i'
   112:       changed_when: true   # only runs when 'creates' target is absent
   113:       when: hermes_install_agent | default(true) | bool
   114: 
   115:     - name: Confirm the Hermes CLI and capture its version
   116:       ansible.builtin.command:
   117:         cmd: "{{ hermes_home }}/.local/bin/hermes --version"
   118:       become: true
   119:       become_user: "{{ hermes_user }}"
   120:       become_flags: '-i'
   121:       register: hermes_version
   122:       changed_when: false
   123:       when: hermes_install_agent | default(true) | bool
   124: 
   125:     # Guardrail: prove `hermes` resolves by name in the hermes user's LOGIN shell
   126:     # (not just via the absolute path above). This catches the missing-dotfiles /
   127:     # PATH regression where ~/.local/bin never gets added to PATH. -lc forces a
   128:     # login shell so ~/.bash_profile -> ~/.bashrc -> ~/.local/bin apply.
   129:     - name: Verify the hermes CLI is on the hermes user login-shell PATH
   130:       ansible.builtin.command:
   131:         cmd: bash -lc 'command -v hermes'
   132:       become: true
   133:       become_user: "{{ hermes_user }}"
   134:       become_flags: '-i'
   135:       register: hermes_on_path
   136:       changed_when: false
   137:       failed_when: hermes_on_path.rc != 0 or 'hermes' not in hermes_on_path.stdout
   138:       when: hermes_install_agent | default(true) | bool
   139: 
   140:     # The Hermes agent venv is created by `uv venv`, which does NOT seed pip.
   141:     # The ansible.builtin.pip task below drives the venv's own pip interpreter,
   142:     # so pip must exist inside the venv first — seed it with uv (the tool that
   143:     # built the venv; ships at ~/.hermes/bin/uv). Idempotent via `creates`.
   144:     # Without this, a fresh converge fails the anthropic install with
   145:     # "Unable to find pip in the virtualenv ... under any of these names: pip3, pip".
   146:     - name: Ensure pip exists in the uv-built Hermes agent venv
   147:       ansible.builtin.command:
   148:         cmd: >-
   149:           {{ hermes_state_mount }}/bin/uv pip install
   150:           --python {{ hermes_state_mount }}/hermes-agent/venv/bin/python pip
   151:         creates: "{{ hermes_state_mount }}/hermes-agent/venv/bin/pip"
   152:       become: true
   153:       become_user: "{{ hermes_user }}"
   154:       become_flags: '-i'
   155:       when: hermes_install_agent | default(true) | bool
   156: 
   157:     # The agent needs the `anthropic` client to talk to models served over the
   158:     # Anthropic Messages API surface — which on opencode-go includes MiniMax and
   159:     # Qwen. Without it the agent aborts at init ("The 'anthropic' package is
   160:     # required for the Anthropic provider"). Hermes does not always pull it into
   161:     # its own venv, so install it here (idempotent). GLM/Kimi use the OpenAI
   162:     # surface and don't need it. Runs in the egress-open install window.
